body:
Every time someone tries to put the real subject into words, it comes out slightly beside the point.

They file the complaint about the schedule when it is about respect; management fixes the schedule, and the problem survives intact.

With Mercury quincunx Lilith, people can name what is nameable while the grievance keeps arriving without a caption.

So they keep correcting each accurate-sounding sentence with another one.

The conversations may continue indefinitely, but the matter only resolves when someone names it at the right altitude.
